1.alliance: Human starting example: A Threat Within, then Kobold Camp Cleanup. Dwarf and Night Elf characters should finish their own starting-area introductions before choosing a travel route.
1.horde: Undead starting example: Rude Awakening. Orc/Troll starting example: Your Place In The World. Follow your own starting-area chain rather than traveling to another race's start.
1.gear: Priest planning: at Classic level 5, check Lesser Magic Wand as an early damage goal. It is a planning reference, not a bundled Forever item benchmark; keep any usable starting weapon until the live requirement is confirmed.
1.craft: Consider an enchanter-made Lesser Magic Wand or a low-cost purchase when available. Do not change professions or spend travel money solely because a Classic guide names the item.
1.gate: Finish your race's starter handoffs and class introduction. A named starting example is not a cross-race quest offer.

6.alliance: Elwynn example: combine Kobold Candles with Gold Dust Exchange when offered. Other starting zones should finish their local chain before a long trip to Westfall.
6.horde: Tirisfal example: The Chill of Death can be planned with nearby Brill errands; confirm the required thread and pelts in the quest log. Durotar characters should finish their own local chain.
6.classQuest: Priest-only Classic level-10 checks: Human/Dwarf Desperate Prayer, Night Elf Returning Home, Troll Hex of Weakness, Undead Touch of Weakness. Forever's racial-spell rules must be checked at the trainer.
6.gear: Retain or inspect an affordable Lesser Magic Wand. The source-confirmed Forever Fire Wand (ID 5069) requires level 7, but its acquisition source was not established; do not invent a vendor or farming trip.
6.craft: Save cloth for useful bags or your chosen profession. Compare the cost of buying an early wand with crafting it; recipe access and live profession rules are not inferred.
6.gate: Class training and a safe exit from the starting zone take priority over optional elite finales. Confirm the actual wand requirement and weapon training.

11.alliance: Westfall example: advance The Defias Brotherhood handoffs while combining local quest loops. Do not enter Deadmines with only the first chain step in your log.
11.horde: Crossroads example: start The Forgotten Pools and the oases investigations. This is preparation toward the later Leaders of the Fang dungeon quest, not an instruction to enter Wailing Caverns immediately.
11.gear: Priest planning: Greater Magic Wand is a Classic level-13 milestone. A Forever guide also reports it at 13; actual price, binding, usability and improvement over your owned wand still require inspection.
11.craft: The Forever guide reports Greater Magic Wand at Enchanting 70. Check the live recipe or ask an enchanter; purchase may cost less than training a profession just for this item.
11.gate: Defias and oases handoffs must be progressed before their final dungeon objectives. Minimum quest levels do not establish a safe party level.

16.alliance: Finish the supported Defias chain, collect its final dungeon quest and plan one prepared Deadmines visit. Staff of Westfall is a source-backed acquisition candidate; check weapon training before selecting it.
16.horde: Progress the oases investigation and its Thunder Bluff handoffs before Leaders of the Fang. Collect Serpentbloom if offered before the Wailing Caverns run; do not assume the group can finish every collection in one visit.
16.gear: Holy Priest: compare the verified Pristine Gloves record with what you own. For a Classic Horde weapon reference, Crescent Staff is a Leaders of the Fang reward; its Forever stats and eligibility are not bundled as a benchmark.
16.classQuest: At Classic level 20, Priest racial quest checks differ by race: A Lack of Fear, Arcane Feedback, Elune's Grace, Shadowguard or Devouring Plague. Treat these as trainer checks in Forever, not guaranteed unlocks.
16.craft: Pristine Gloves is a source-confirmed level-15 item with Tailoring 75 and a maker restriction. Confirm pattern access and materials before reserving funds.
16.gate: Plan the dungeon around all party members' actual readiness. A quest reward may be one-time; choose it deliberately and avoid duplicate acquisition if already owned.

21.alliance: Collect The Fury Runs Deep if eligible before a Stockade outing. For ordinary leveling, choose nearby Wetlands or Duskwood work rather than repeatedly traveling for an isolated item.
21.horde: The Ashenvale Hunt is a named Splintertree Post objective to investigate when offered. Its creature targets can require help; do not treat the band as a soloability guarantee.
21.gear: Prepare Pristine Leggings for level 25 only if the maker/profession gates fit your plan. Gravestone Scepter is a source-confirmed Forever item tied to Blackfathom Villainy for both factions; it is a quest-planning reference here, not a proven current-level ranking.
21.craft: Check Tailoring 125, maker restrictions and the disputed Pristine Leggings recipe source before buying materials. Avoid crafting it if an owned alternative already meets your needs.
21.gate: Collect available Blackfathom or Stockade quests before entry. The source lists Blackfathom Villainy from Classic level 18, but party readiness and live availability remain separate checks.

26.alliance: Collect The Grand Betrayal before a planned Gnomeregan run; finish its available handoffs first. Continue the ordinary Wetlands/Duskwood route while forming the group.
26.horde: Collect Rig Wars before Gnomeregan when available. Consider Razorfen Kraul as a separate prepared outing rather than assuming a Gnomeregan trip also advances its boss goals.
26.gear: Use the verified Holy sample: Death Speaker Robes at source level 26, Death Speaker Mantle at 27, and Gilded Slippers at 30. Owned items and manual gate status change the adaptive action list.
26.craft: Gilded Slippers requires source Tailoring 150 and level 30; check maker/workstation requirements. Keep the leggings recipe conflict visible rather than assuming it was resolved.
26.gate: Quest pickup, dungeon difficulty, item wear level and recipe skill are different gates. Do not pay for a short-lived farm merely to fill a sample target.

31.alliance: Use the early Tiger Mastery and Panther Mastery steps as a shared Stranglethorn circuit when suitable. Prepare Mythology of the Titans before a Scarlet Monastery Library visit if offered.
31.horde: Use the same early mastery circuit when suitable; Into The Scarlet Monastery is a group-quest preparation check from Classic level 33. Test of Lore is worthwhile only if its earlier chain already fits your route.
31.gear: Classic Priest references: Illusionary Rod or Hypnotic Blade from Arcanist Doan. Their Classic wear levels are around the next part of this band; verify the actual tooltip and compare a dagger plus off-hand as a set. No Forever ranking is asserted.
31.craft: Review useful bag capacity, such as the Classic Mageweave Bag recipe, using gathered cloth. Do not push an expensive craft only to replace a functional bag or leveling item.
31.gate: Check Library objectives before travel and obtain the Scarlet Key if your later-wing plan requires it. Do not send an Undead character to Compendium of the Fallen: the Classic guide excludes that race.

36.alliance: In the Name of the Light is a prepared multi-wing Scarlet Monastery objective. Its Classic prerequisite is Down the Scarlet Path; verify the chain before planning the party route.
36.horde: Into The Scarlet Monastery is the corresponding multi-wing objective. Agree on Library, Armory and Cathedral targets with the group instead of assuming one wing completes it.
36.gear: Classic quest references: Orb of Lorica for Alliance or Prophetic Cane for Horde as off-hand choices. Keep a strong existing weapon if the complete one-hand/off-hand combination is not clearly better.
36.craft: Preserve travel and mobility funds. Craft practical bags or consumables only when their live cost and requirements justify the benefit; avoid filling every slot for the sake of a checklist.
36.gate: Later wings and their bosses are harder than early wings. The Scarlet Key and prior quest chain are preparation checks, not proof your party is ready.

41.alliance: Combine Wastewander Justice and Water Pouch Bounty in a Tanaris circuit. Start Screecher Spirits only when its travel fits the next dungeon plan.
41.horde: Use the same Tanaris circuit and prepare Gahz'rilla and The Prophecy of Mosh'aru before the coordinated Zul'Farrak visit.
41.gear: Classic Priest reference: inspect Blackbone Wand at a capital's wand vendor when already visiting. Do not make a long trip or assume it beats a good owned wand; Forever availability and value are unverified.
41.craft: Stock appropriate food, drink and mana supplies before the run. Ask a crafter or buy only what you will use; the addon does not establish profession-specific potion usability.
41.gate: Screecher Spirits precedes The Prophecy of Mosh'aru in the Classic chain. Confirm a party member's Mallet of Zul'Farrak before committing to Gahz'rilla.

46.alliance: The Stave of Equinex leads to The Morrow Stone in the Classic Feralas route. Combine it with nearby work only when the live prerequisites and target difficulty fit.
46.horde: Continue prepared Tanaris and Feralas objectives; finish The Prophecy of Mosh'aru before advancing The Ancient Egg. Reserve Jintha'Alor or other elite steps for suitable help.
46.gear: Classic Priest references: Cairnstone Sliver from The Morrow Stone (Alliance) or Noxious Shooter from Noxxion in Maraudon. They are planning examples, not Forever-verified upgrades or guaranteed drops.
46.craft: Review an eventual Runecloth Bag or other capacity upgrade against its recipe and material cost. Keep a reserve for essential training rather than forcing profession skill gains now.
46.gate: A dungeon drop is uncertain; a quest reward still needs the entire chain. Keep the source's Sacred Mallet/Jintha'Alor preparation separate from ordinary solo leveling.

51.alliance: Batch Crystals of Power with the Eastern, Northern and Western Pylon investigations when offered in Un'Goro. Continue Felwood hubs when the next Un'Goro tasks are unsuitable.
51.horde: Use the same crystal/pylon circuit; complete needed Yeh'kinya preparations before The God Hakkar in Sunken Temple rather than arriving without the chain.
51.gear: Classic Priest reference: Rod of Corrosion from Shade of Eranikus in Sunken Temple. Assess the whole role set and actual requirements; the Forever record and drop likelihood are unverified.
51.craft: Craft or buy a Runecloth Bag only after checking recipe access and useful capacity. Begin budgeting for confirmed lasting crafts; do not buy an expensive Classic endgame recipe on assumption alone.
51.gate: Crystals of Power is a prerequisite for the pylon steps. Sunken Temple chains can include earlier dungeon objectives and travel; a class quest is not automatically offered to every profile.

56.alliance: Batch Demon Dogs, Blood Tinged Skies and Carrion Grubbage from Tirion Fordring. That's Asking A Lot is a preparation check before When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent.
56.horde: The same neutral Tirion circuit can fit the final leveling push. Plan the Smokey chain only if its supply costs and dangerous objectives make sense for your character or group.
56.gear: Classic Priest reference: Smokey's Fireshooter from When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent. Treat a possible reward as a reason to prepare the chain, not a claim that its guarded objectives are safe solo.
56.craft: Priest-only long-term Classic reference: Truefaith Vestments, a Tailoring 300 craft with a maker/class restriction. Verify Forever recipe availability before reserving rare materials or changing professions.
56.gate: Keep normal quest mobs separate from elite finales and dungeon access tasks. Keys, party readiness and quest eligibility must be confirmed in the live game.

60.alliance: If available and relevant, combine Attunement to the Core with an agreed Blackrock Depths route. Choose one access goal and one role-gearing goal for the session.
60.horde: Use the same neutral attunement planning check if available. Verify your faction's other access chains separately rather than assuming another player's completed prerequisites apply to you.
60.gear: Classic Priest references: Truefaith Vestments as a profession option and Benediction as a later raid-linked objective. Neither is represented as verified Forever level-60 BiS; the current benchmark is unavailable.
60.craft: Only commit to a lasting craft or enchant after confirming the live recipe, binding, profession and budget. Keep horizontal role sets separate from a percentage-to-BiS claim.
60.gate: The Classic Benediction route begins with The Eye of Divinity from Majordomo Executus before The Balance of Light and Shadow. Actual Forever raid access, item availability and tuning are unverified.
